flows.title: Add an account for a new user
steps: This needs the User management privilege. Without it, not all of the controls below are visible.
In the Google Admin console, go to Menu, then Directory, then Users.
At the top of the user list, click Add new user.

Enter the user's first and last name, and accept or change the suggested Primary email. If the organization has more than one domain, click the Down arrow to the right of the @ sign and choose a domain.
Recommended: enter a Secondary email, a current address where the user can receive their new account details. Optional: enter a phone number.
Click Add New User, then click Done.
stops: pressing Add New User, which creates the account and raises the monthly payment on a Flexible Plan
changing the subscription or adding licences to make room for a new user
